title: Testing machine-learned basal-friction relationships for ice-sheet modeling
testbed_rationale: Presentation slides from a workshop session; no dataset or code links or explicit repository information are provided.
pain_points: In-distribution errors: predictor values overlap between glaciers but predicted friction and velocity responses are still incorrect

Input variables from local point-wise observations do not uniquely determine basal friction (missing physics like subgrid roughness, hydrology proxies, sediment properties, and nonlocal stress balance)
Lack of generalization across different glacier systems and flow regimes
extraction_notes: Extracted from presentation slides presented at a CESM ML session referring to an in-preparation/current manuscript.
